_comment: Model descriptions Jev chooses between (policy.models[*].good_at/weak_at/cost). Jev never sees names or numbers; these words are the whole basis of its pick. Sources: OpenRouter benchmark indices + warslop gates of 2026-10-20 (Indonesian answer, tool call, first token, Chinese-leak runs). Cost words: OpenCode Go models are included in a flat subscription; OpenRouter models are pay per use.

ocgoa/opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.good_at: everyday questions, homework help, writing in natural Indonesian, coding and tool use; answers quickly

ocgob/opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding and multi-step tool use (strong coding results), clear Indonesian, fast answers

openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding and multi-step tool use (strong coding results), clear Indonesian, the fastest to start answering

ocgoa/opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.good_at: short general questions and simple writing; fast

ocgob/opencode-go/gpt-6-luna.good_at: careful reasoning and polished, well-structured writing in Indonesian and English, such as CVs, letters and reports

openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.good_at: the strongest here at hard reasoning, careful analysis of documents and data, high-stakes advice and long multi-step tool use; quick
openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.cost: pay per use, the most expensive option here

openrouter/openai/gpt-6-luna.good_at: careful reasoning and polished, well-structured writing in Indonesian and English

ocpv/opencode-go/beam-free.good_at: everyday questions and writing in clean Indonesian, simple tool use

openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-.good_at: reasoning, maths and code, with clean Indonesian
openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-.weak_at: can be slow on long answers

ocpv/opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash-free.good_at: the strongest free option at hard reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use
ocpv/opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash-free.weak_at: sometimes mixes Chinese words into Indonesian answers

openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:fr.good_at: the strongest free option at hard reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use
openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:fr.weak_at: sometimes mixes Chinese words into Indonesian answers
